about: QA-415 (P-486, the tech lead's ruling 12 Nov; P-489): each person's kind of application is worked out from that person's own filing, never asked (EXPERIENCE: each fact asked once, worked out where the case knows it; QA-400's pattern). The engine (engine/runtime/application-kind.ts) finds each person's filing the way the case's filings are found (engine/runtime/filings.ts deriveFilings: the filing their line adds, else the filing their role makes, else the combination's own) and writes person.application_type from this table: a filing a line or a role names is read by its name ("filings"), the combination's own filing by the combination's key ("combinations"). A filing this table does not name gives no value: its form fields go by hand with the reason, never a guess. The words are the forms' own: IMM 5645's "Type of application: Visitor Worker Student Other" and IMM 5476's "Type of application (permanent residence, extension of study permit, etc.)". Data, not code (P-319): the engine names no form, combination or program.
status: Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. The words are quoted from the forms below; which word each filing takes is the tech lead's reading of IRCC's pages (P-486) until the immigration expert confirms. IMM 5476 and IMM 5475 ask the type of application under "If you have already submitted your application" (IMM 5476 instructions, Question 4): whether it is written before the application is submitted is for the expert to confirm (review m5 on #1620).
